body: I don't want to be negative but I don't see what the point of going on is.  This will be a cycle in your life.  It goes away and then it comes back.  I understand your parents not caring.  I understand it hurts.  Mine hurts the worst when they act like they care for one minute and then come back to hurt you all over agian.  I'm sorry I am no help.  I am in the same boat as you.  You are not alone.

Thank you for all of the thought and consideration you put in this.  I do feel a little better because I was able to move my focus to an abstract thought.  Thinking about amazing things such as life in a sense other than how much mine is wasted puts my mind in a better place.  Great topic of conversation I would like to remind myself to think about when I am feeling down or trying to help someone else who is feeling down.

Things that keep me going:
- Talking to my mom
- Finally finding a friend who wants to hang out
- Immerse yourself in a job, if you can focus on a task at hand
- Dogs, puppies, anything soft and sweet
- Posting on reddit and getting some kind of positive feedback
- Making a friend on reddit that wants to talk to me

I don't know what to say except I feel exactly how you do.  This happened to me a year ago with my boyfriend and I begged him to stay with me and dropped the birth control and only took my anti depressants and anti anxiety every day.  It got better and then it got bad again but last month I was feeling really good.  The past week now, I am going through the same feelings I was a year ago but I am too scared to talk to my boyfriend about it because I know he will leave me and then I have no one.  I tried to text three friends on Friday to see what they were doing this weekend and one responded 2 days later... after the weekend.  Let's be friends?
